# Lily Design System™

> Free, open-source, headless design system: a canonical catalog of 491
> accessible components implemented across seven frameworks (HTML, Svelte,
> React, Vue, Angular, Blazor, Nunjucks), paired with fully styled example
> apps that demonstrate the same catalog end to end.

This is the canonical monorepo. The living specification is `spec/`,
entered via `spec/index.md`; binding design-principle rules for AI coding
agents live in `AGENTS.md` and `AGENTS/*.md`. Public documentation and the
searchable component catalog: https://lilydesignsystem.github.io/.

## Start here

- [spec/index.md](spec/index.md): the specification — vision, scope,
  architecture, naming conventions, composition patterns, acceptance
  criteria, roadmap. Links out to one `spec/{topic}/index.md` per topic.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): binding design-principle rules; loads every file
  under `AGENTS/`.
- [README.md](README.md): human-readable project overview.
- [components.tsv](components.tsv): the canonical 491-component catalog —
  one row per component: slug, PascalCase name, description.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): full change history, with the reasoning
  behind each change.

## Design-principle rules (AGENTS/)

- [AGENTS/headless.md](AGENTS/headless.md): markup, ARIA, behaviour
  boundaries, zero-CSS rules every component follows.
- [AGENTS/accessibility.md](AGENTS/accessibility.md): WCAG 2.2 AAA target,
  WAI-ARIA APG keyboard/role/state patterns.
- [AGENTS/internationalization.md](AGENTS/internationalization.md): no
  hardcoded user-facing strings, stable text-prop names.
- [AGENTS/theme.md](AGENTS/theme.md): token shape, the headless
  forbidden-literal list, the 45 reference theme stylesheets.
- [AGENTS/components.md](AGENTS/components.md): suffix-to-HTML-element
  mapping, compound name-family patterns, composition templates.
- [AGENTS/helpers.md](AGENTS/helpers.md): the theme/locale/text-size/
  share/date-time picker contract.
- [AGENTS/citations.md](AGENTS/citations.md): design systems and headless
  libraries Lily learns from.
- [AGENTS/lily.md](AGENTS/lily.md): the full subproject list (all 7
  headless, 7 example, 7 helper catalogs) and the `bin/` tool reference.

## Specification topics (spec/)

- [spec/architecture/index.md](spec/architecture/index.md): monorepo
  layout, the git-subtree model, required files per subproject/component.
- [spec/components/index.md](spec/components/index.md): the 491-component
  catalog in depth, per-component documentation requirements.
- [spec/testing/index.md](spec/testing/index.md): per-framework test
  suites, Storybook coverage, Playwright e2e, axe, responsive sweep.
- [spec/national-identifiers/index.md](spec/national-identifiers/index.md):
  the 92 national personal identifier components, validation algorithms.
- [spec/helpers/index.md](spec/helpers/index.md): the five `*-picker`
  helper contracts in full.
- [spec/frameworks/index.md](spec/frameworks/index.md): the seven
  framework pairs, per-framework file shapes, the copy-pattern.
- [spec/agent-skills/index.md](spec/agent-skills/index.md): the
  `lily-design-system-skill` and `lily-design-system-maintainer-skill` Claude Skills.

## Subprojects

- [lily-design-system-svelte-headless](lily-design-system-svelte-headless/index.md):
  the canonical Svelte 5 headless library — other catalogs port from it.
- [lily-design-system-svelte-sveltekit-examples](lily-design-system-svelte-sveltekit-examples/index.md):
  fully styled reference app for the same catalog.
- [lily-design-system-svelte-helpers](lily-design-system-svelte-helpers/index.md):
  the canonical theme/locale/text-size/share/date-time picker catalog.
- The remaining 18 headless/example/helper subprojects (React, Vue,
  Angular, Blazor, HTML, Nunjucks) follow the same shape — see
  [AGENTS/lily.md](AGENTS/lily.md) for the full list.
- [lily-design-system-skill](lily-design-system-skill/SKILL.md): general-purpose Claude Skill
  explaining Lily concepts and usage to people building *with* the system.
- [lily-design-system-maintainer-skill](lily-design-system-maintainer-skill/SKILL.md):
  technical Claude Skill for maintainers working *on* this monorepo.

## Optional

- [components-categories.tsv](components-categories.tsv): per-component
  HTML tag and category (content, forms, navigation, tables, …).
- [css-style-sheet-template.css](css-style-sheet-template.css): one CSS
  class hook declared per catalog component.
- [themes/](themes/): 45 ready-to-use reference theme stylesheets (NHS
  England/Scotland/Wales, GOV.UK, USWDS, Adobe Spectrum, Mozilla Protocol).
- [bin/](bin/): scaffolding, listing, sync, test, and publish tooling —
  start with `bin/test` to verify a working tree.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to propose a change.
- [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md): MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-only OR
  GPL-3.0-only OR BSD-3-Clause.
